questions.prompt: Which US state was the last to be admitted to the Union?
questions.fact: It joined in 1959, a few months after Alaska, making 1959 the only year two states were admitted.

questions.prompt: Which planet has a moon called Europa?
questions.fact: It probably holds more liquid water beneath its ice than all Earth's oceans combined.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a race over hurdles for horses?
questions.fact: Horses in it typically peak later than flat racers, and many compete into their teens.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character called Elle Woods?
questions.fact: Harvard Law School has reported that applications from women rose noticeably after its release.

questions.prompt: Which is the second-largest country in Africa by area?
questions.fact: It contains most of the world's second-largest rainforest, after the Amazon.

questions.prompt: Which term describes an extended metaphor running through a poem?
questions.fact: Metaphysical poets pushed them to extremes, comparing lovers to a pair of drawing compasses in one famous case.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym API gateway do?
questions.fact: It usually handles authentication and rate limiting too, so individual services do not each reimplement them.
